title: Artificial Intelligence, Sustainability at Forefront As Industry Turns Attention to 2024
summary: Intense, urgent demand for artificial intelligence (AI) capabilities – and the dueling pressure to reduce energy consumption, costs and greenhouse gas emissions – loom large over the data center industry heading into 2024. The proliferation of AI (as Vertiv predicted two years ago) along with the infrastructure and sustainability challenges inherent in AI-capable computing can be felt across the industry and throughout the 2024 data center trends forecast from Vertiv (NYSE: VRT), a global provider of critical digital infrastructure and continuity solutions.
